ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: To leave everyone under heaven in doubt is to make a word, gesture, or case remain publicly unsettled. Masters attach the verdict to questions, displayed objects, inherited cases, and replies that keep later readers arguing.
EvidenceBody: Fogu Wen answers his teacher with the verdict; Guishan applies it to Yangshan’s one sentence; Haiyin rests it on the staff, while Yunwaize gives the same answer to both Deshan’s staff and Linji’s shout.
